rules.rationale: Source value prior +6.89 for smiles_short; small solutes pay little cavity-formation cost in water.
Source prior -6.61 for smiles_mid; added nonpolar surface raises hydration cost relative to gains.
Strongest source prior (-11.46) at smiles_long; bulky hydrophobic solutes are poorly hydrated.
Ring role carried the top transfer weight (0.758); acyclic small solutes expose less hydrophobic ring surface.

skills.hypothesis: Transfers ESOL size and ring-structure roles to hydration, treating molecular bulk as the main penalty. May fail on seeds where top solutes are polar yet mid-length, and seed variance remains high.

rules.rationale: Cavity-formation work scales with solute volume, so the smallest solutes retain the most favorable hydration terms.
Branch role transferred strongly (0.758); unbranched chains give compact, well-solvated geometries with less buried nonpolar surface.
Counter-hypothesis: the smiles_mid prior had lowest confidence (0.27), so its penalty is neutralized rather than trusted.
Perhalogenated surfaces are weakly polarizable hydrogen-bond non-donors, giving unfavorable aqueous solvation despite modest size.

skills.hypothesis: Keeps the compact-solute signal but downweights the weak mid-length penalty and adds halogen hydrophobicity, leaning harder on target-only GP evidence. Fails if mid-length penalty is genuinely strong.

lesson: Development seeds favored the source-grounded size/ring transfer (mean AUC 72.9) over the polarity-driven counter skill (54.3), so the low-confidence ESOL priors still carried usable signal and should not have been discarded on mechanistic intuition alone.
revision_summary: Reinstated and slightly strengthened the size/ring transfer skill (higher short-SMILES weight, larger and slower-decaying semantic mass, more early exploration to address the wide per-seed spread) and made it the deployed skill. Replaced the underperforming heteroatom-polarity skill with a milder counter-hypothesis that keeps the compact-solute term, neutralizes only the lowest-confidence smiles_mid prior, adds an unbranched-backbone and halogen-hydrophobicity rule, and shifts more rank mass to the target-only anchor. Mechanism claims remain hypotheses; eight development seeds cannot establish causality.
